verdict.rationale: telli ships a built-in AI assistant, Charlie, documented to 'analyze your calls' inside the product, so AI-driven analysis of user data is a first-party capability. The evidence is a single high-level mention, though. Metrics dashboards and transcript review are standard analytics, not AI-generated insights. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights or suggestions Charlie produces from call and contact data, proactive recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Charlie: Build and refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze your calls with telli's built-in AI assistant.
